ValidationRule.description: What the first pass said can't be changed by anyone, admins included, so the reviewer decides on exactly what was proposed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISCHANGED(Checklist_Item__c), ISCHANGED(Content_Version_Id__c), ISCHANGED(Model__c), ISCHANGED(Verdict__c), ISCHANGED(Reasons__c), ISCHANGED(Tampering_Excerpt__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The first-pass verdict can't be edited. Decide the review instead.
